newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech central bank proposes CSOB, Sporitelna merger-paper.
newsitem.headline: Czech central bank proposes CSOB, Sporitelna merger-paper.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) has called for the fast privatisation of the state stakes in bank IPB a.s. and for merger of savings bank Ceska Sporitelna a.s. and Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s., an economic daily reported on Wednesday.

Hospodarske Noviny said the central bank had already submitted the plan to the cabinet whose final approval is necessary for such a move. The basic contents of the story were confirmed to Reuters by a senior central bank official.

The paper quoted central bank sources as saying that the proposed merger would create the largest bank in the region, but it would be necessary to delay its full privatisation for three to five years until effects of the merger are analysed.
The proposal does not plan a fast selloff of the largest Czech commercial bank, Komercni Banka a.s., it said.
